name: Apollo 12 Landing Site

locations.label: Intrepid LM Descent Stage, Oceanus Procellarum

summary: Apollo 12 demonstrated precision pinpoint landing on another celestial body.
hook: I landed within 200 meters of Surveyor 3 to prove pinpoint lunar landing accuracy.
how_it_worked: Achieved precision landing using radar updates and deployed an ALSEP science station powered by an RTG.
science: Recorded eight years of continuous seismic and solar wind data using its nuclear-powered station.

facts.text: Astronauts walked over to the robotic Surveyor 3 lander and inspected parts exposed to vacuum for over two years.
Left a SNAP-27 radioisotope thermoelectric generator on the Moon that transmitted data until 1977.

image.alt: Astronaut Alan Bean works at the equipment stowage bay of the Apollo 12 Lunar Module
